text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Rulership showed up for the meeting,
he was carrying a heavy-looking plastic bag.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...This is pure fuel.
At times like this, you've gotta go with the classic flavor.
It gives you that hard-hitting punch, and that's the best...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Peering into the bag—
I found it crammed full of energy drinks.
At this rate, she's going to ruin her health...!
choice_data_list: I can't just overlook you taking in that huge amount.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue seems to be catching up with Rulership after a string of races.
I should probably reconsider her race schedule...
